headline: On last trading session, Sensex and Nifty ended in red, snapping a four-week winning streak

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Profit booking at higher levels snapped the market's four-week winning streak.
Rising Brent crude oil prices topping $97 per barrel weighed on investor sentiment.
Selling pressure in IT stocks dragged the key benchmark indices lower.
Mid-week recovery lost momentum amid cautious global and domestic cues.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty 50 snapped a four-week rally to close the week in the red.
TCS led gains among major IT names, while Tata Steel lagged performance.
Metals outperformed during the session even as IT dragged early trading.
The Indian stock market is closed today for the weekend and reopens on Monday, 30 November.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices ended lower, snapping a four-week winning streak as profit booking took hold. Brent crude surging past $97 per barrel and weakness in IT stocks weighed on the market. TCS stood out with gains while Tata Steel lagged, with markets remaining closed today for the weekend.
